summary: Rewrote upload_file in archive/hollin.py for Hollin v3 and the upload client standard: plan-based chunk size, parts numbered from 1 with sha256 base64 Part-Checksum, file checksum as unpadded base64url with a part-count suffix, resume rules, parts_missing retry and a single replacement session on 410. Checked against a simulated server and the docs' checksum examples; there was no real Hollin server to test against.
